name: Imouto Rental
source:
Main character wants so bad to be called "Onii-chan". He also wants to find a girl who would live only for him. He finds "Sister rental" service that promises to make all his sister dreams come true. Organization is somewhat suspicious, but offer is too good not to take.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公极度渴望被人称作“哥哥”，也想找到一个能只为自己而活的女孩。
他发现一项承诺实现一切妹妹幻想的“妹妹租赁”服务。
组织似乎有些可疑，但条件实在诱人，令人难以拒绝。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
